conventions.id: 3-digit string, permanent, never reused. Blocks: 101-139 offense play cards, 141-149 offense base plays (reusable), 151-199 offense specials, 201-249 defense reads (reusable), 251-299 defense specials, 301-349 either side, 901-999 non-card assets (backs).
conventions.files: {id}_{slug}_{asset}[_v{n}].png where asset is 'art' (illustration only) or 'card' (full rendered card). Tooling matches on the id prefix only; the slug is for humans and may change if a card is renamed.
conventions.copies: Map of deck -> copies. Decks: offense-plays, offense-specials, offense-reusable, defense-specials, defense-reusable. Reusable decks hold cards that stay in hand all game.

cards.name: Dive
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 4 yards; 2 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.
cards.flavorText: Three yards and a cloud of dust. Make it four.

art.brief: Fullback plowing straight ahead, helmet-first into a pile

cards.name: Off Tackle
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 7 yards; 3 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Running back cutting off a pulling guard's block

cards.name: Power Sweep
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 11 yards; 3 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.
cards.flavorText: Here they come. Everybody knows it.

art.brief: Runner turning the corner behind a wall of linemen

cards.name: Toss Sweep
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 18 yards; 2 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Speedster catching a pitch, already outrunning the defense to the sideline

cards.name: QB Sneak
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 2 yards; 1 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Quarterback burrowing under a pile of linemen, ball stretched forward

cards.name: Draw
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 9 yards; 1 if the defense reads Run. If the defense read Blitz, gains 6 more yards.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.
cards.flavorText: Come on in. Make yourselves at home.

art.brief: Quarterback dropping back as if to pass, then slipping the ball to the running back past charging rushers

cards.name: Reverse
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 15 yards. A Run read doesn't stop it. A Pass or Blitz read holds it to 0.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Receiver taking a handoff running the opposite way, the whole defense flowing the wrong direction

cards.name: Quick Out
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 3 yards; 2 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.
cards.flavorText: Get it out. Get it out.

art.brief: Receiver snapping a short out route to the sideline

cards.name: Slant
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 8 yards; 3 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Receiver knifing across the middle, ball already in the air

cards.name: Dig
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 13 yards; 3 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Receiver settling into a hole in the zone, defenders converging too late

cards.name: Seam Route
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 20 yards; 5 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Tight end splitting two safeties down the middle

cards.name: Go Route
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 35 yards; 0 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.
cards.flavorText: Just throw it up. He's open. He's always open.

art.brief: Receiver a full stride past the last defender, arms out for a deep ball

cards.name: Screen Pass
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 6 yards; 1 if the defense reads Pass. A Blitz read doesn't stop it; against Blitz it gains 6 more yards.
cards.reminderText: Correct read: the play is held to its read yards, and your level doesn't rise.

art.brief: Running back catching a soft toss behind a convoy of linemen while rushers fly past

cards.name: Inside Zone
cards.rulesText: Run. Gain 2 yards; 0 if the defense reads Run.
cards.reminderText: Reusable: always in your hand; returns after use.

art.brief: Running back pressing the line behind a double-team block

cards.name: Check Down
cards.rulesText: Pass. Gain 2 yards; 0 if the defense reads Pass.
cards.reminderText: Reusable: always in your hand; returns after use.

art.brief: Quarterback dumping a short pass to a running back in the flat

cards.name: Sticky Fingers
cards.rulesText: For the rest of this possession, the defense can't play interception cards on any snap with more than 5 yards to go.
cards.reminderText: Blocks cards tagged #interception (Hijacked, Pick Six).

art.brief: Receiver, gloves glued to the ball

cards.name: 4th and OMG
cards.rulesText: Play on 4th & 1 on your own side of the 50. TOUCHDOWN.
cards.reminderText: Spends your whole bank. Countered by Goal Line Stand.
cards.flavorText: Nobody saw it coming. Including us.

art.brief: Runner bursting free, crowd losing it

cards.name: Hard Count
cards.rulesText: The defense reveals its read first. You may swap your play card for another from your hand, paying any difference.

art.brief: Quarterback barking at the line while a defensive lineman leans offside

cards.name: Audible
cards.rulesText: Swap your play card for one of the same type from your hand, paying any difference.

art.brief: Quarterback pointing and shouting changes at the line

cards.name: Play Action
cards.rulesText: If the defense read Run, your Pass gains double its printed yardage.

art.brief: Quarterback faking a handoff, linebackers biting hard

cards.name: Hurry-Up
cards.rulesText: For the rest of this possession, after a successful play the defense must repeat its previous read on the next snap.
cards.reminderText: Ended by Timeout.

art.brief: Offense sprinting to the line, defenders gasping for air

cards.name: Two-Minute Drill
cards.rulesText: Your level rises even if this play was read.

art.brief: Quarterback rallying the huddle under a giant stopwatch

cards.name: Broken Tackle
cards.rulesText: If your Run was read, it gains its printed yardage minus 3 instead of its read yards.

art.brief: Runner shrugging off a tackler who is flying backward

cards.name: Hail Mary
cards.rulesText: Play as your play card (Pass). TOUCHDOWN if the defense read Run; otherwise incomplete.

art.brief: Ball arcing high into a crowd of jumping players, everybody looking up

cards.name: Fake Punt
cards.rulesText: Play on 4th & 5 or less. Automatic first down.

art.brief: Punter tucking the ball and running, special teams in shock

cards.name: Ball Security
cards.rulesText: Cancel PunchBall or Strip Sack.

art.brief: Runner cradling the ball with both arms, a fist bouncing off

cards.name: Pass Interference
cards.rulesText: Cancel Hijacked or Pick Six. You gain 15 yards and a first down.

art.brief: Defender draped all over a receiver as a yellow flag flies

cards.name: Flea Flicker
cards.rulesText: Play as your play card (Pass). Gain 25 yards unless the defense read Pass. A Blitz read doesn't stop it.

art.brief: Running back pitching the ball back to the quarterback as defenders crash the line

cards.name: Hot Route
cards.rulesText: If the defense read Blitz, your Pass gains half its printed yardage (round down) instead of its read yards, if that's more, and Sack can't be played.

art.brief: Quarterback flicking a quick throw over a blitzing linebacker's hands

cards.name: Silent Count
cards.rulesText: Cancel Gotchya or Crowd Noise.

art.brief: Center glancing back, quarterback silently tapping his leg

cards.name: Roughing the Passer
cards.rulesText: Cancel Sack or Strip Sack. You gain 15 yards and a first down.

art.brief: Defender driving a quarterback into the turf well after the throw, flag in the air

cards.name: Big Leg
cards.rulesText: Play on a field goal attempt. The kick's range is extended by 10 yards.

art.brief: Kicker launching a ball that's still climbing as it clears the frame

cards.name: Fired Up
cards.rulesText: Your bank gains 2 (up to the cap).

art.brief: Offense jumping and chest-bumping in the huddle

cards.name: Swinging Gate
cards.rulesText: Play on a 2-point try. It's good.
cards.reminderText: Countered by Read the Fake.

art.brief: Offensive line split wide toward the sideline, holder sprinting the other way

cards.name: Run Read
cards.rulesText: Commit face-down. Holds Run plays to their read yards.
cards.reminderText: Reusable: you keep all three reads all game.

art.brief: Linebackers crashing the line of scrimmage

cards.name: Pass Read
cards.rulesText: Commit face-down. Holds Pass plays to their read yards.
cards.reminderText: Reusable: you keep all three reads all game.

art.brief: Defensive backs blanketing receivers

cards.name: Blitz Read
cards.rulesText: Commit face-down. Counts as a Pass read. When correct, you may play Sack. When wrong against a Run, the Run gains +3 yards.
cards.reminderText: Reusable: you keep all three reads all game.

art.brief: Everyone rushing the quarterback at once

cards.name: Gotchya
cards.rulesText: False start! The offense's committed cards return to its hand, -5 yards, offense level -1. Replay the down; you may change your read.
cards.reminderText: Can't push the offense back past its own 1. Countered by Silent Count.

art.brief: Defensive lineman twitching, an offensive lineman jumping early

cards.name: Sack
cards.rulesText: Play after a correct Blitz read. -7 yards, offense level resets to 1, and you gain 1.

art.brief: Pass rusher burying the quarterback

cards.name: PunchBall
cards.rulesText: Play after a Run that wasn't read. Fumble: the defense recovers. The possession ends.
cards.reminderText: Countered by Ball Security.

art.brief: Defender's fist punching the ball out of a runner's grip

cards.name: Hijacked
cards.rulesText: Play after a Pass that wasn't read. Intercepted. The possession ends.
cards.reminderText: Blocked by Sticky Fingers. Countered by Pass Interference.

art.brief: Defender leaping over a receiver to snag the ball

cards.name: Stunt
cards.rulesText: A wrong Blitz read against a Run gives up no bonus yards.

art.brief: Two defensive linemen looping around each other

cards.name: Bracket Coverage
cards.rulesText: If your read was wrong against a Pass, it gains only half its yardage (round down).

art.brief: Receiver sandwiched between two defenders

cards.name: Crowd Noise
cards.rulesText: Offense level -1.
cards.reminderText: Countered by Silent Count.

art.brief: Stadium crowd roaring, quarterback cupping an ear

cards.name: Pick Six
cards.rulesText: Play right after Hijacked resolves. The defense scores 7.
cards.reminderText: Countered by Pass Interference.

art.brief: Defender high-stepping into the end zone with the ball

cards.name: Strip Sack
cards.rulesText: Play right after Sack. Fumble: the defense recovers. The possession ends.
cards.reminderText: Countered by Ball Security or Roughing the Passer.

art.brief: Pass rusher swatting the ball from the quarterback's arm mid-sack

cards.name: Goal Line Stand
cards.rulesText: Inside your own 5: a Run read also counts as reading Passes this snap. OR cancel 4th and OMG.

art.brief: Defensive line dug in at the goal line, mud flying

cards.name: Icing the Kicker
cards.rulesText: The field goal range bonus does not apply to this kick.
cards.flavorText: Think about it. Really think about it.

art.brief: Coach calling timeout as the kicker freezes mid-step

cards.name: Film Study
cards.rulesText: Look at the offense's play hand.

art.brief: Defensive coordinator in a dark room, projector light on a wall of diagrams

cards.name: Zone Blitz
cards.rulesText: Your Blitz read also counts as reading Runs this snap. You can't play Sack this snap.
cards.flavorText: Rush five, drop three, confuse everyone.

art.brief: Defensive end dropping into coverage while a cornerback blitzes

cards.name: QB Spy
cards.rulesText: If your read was wrong against a Run, it gains only half its yardage (round down).

art.brief: Linebacker mirroring a scrambling quarterback step for step

cards.name: Prevent Defense
cards.rulesText: A Pass that wasn't read gains at most 12 yards this snap. OR cancel Hail Mary or Flea Flicker.

art.brief: Safeties backpedaling forty yards deep

cards.name: Holding Call
cards.rulesText: Play after the offense gains 10 or more yards. The gain is negated: -10 yards, replay the down.
cards.reminderText: Can be negated by Flag on the Play.

art.brief: Offensive lineman with a fistful of jersey, a flag landing at his feet

cards.name: Blocked Kick
cards.rulesText: Play on a field goal attempt. It's blocked: no points.

art.brief: Defender skying over the line, fingertips meeting the ball

cards.name: Kick Six
cards.rulesText: Play on a field goal attempt of 41 yards or longer. Blocked and returned: the defense scores 7.

art.brief: Returner sprinting the length of the field with a blocked kick, kicker diving in vain

cards.name: Read the Fake
cards.rulesText: Cancel Fake Punt or Swinging Gate.

art.brief: Linebacker pointing at a punter, yelling 'FAKE!'

cards.name: Timeout
cards.rulesText: End Hurry-Up, or cancel Two-Minute Drill.

art.brief: Coach forming a T with both hands on the sideline

cards.name: Rally
cards.rulesText: Your bank gains 2 (up to the cap).

art.brief: Defense huddled, helmets together, shouting

cards.name: Flag on the Play
cards.rulesText: Negate this snap's result. Replay the down.

art.brief: Referee mid-throw of a yellow flag
Offense play deck back: bold pattern, game logo. Base plays share this back.
Defense specials back: bold pattern, game logo, distinct color from offense
Read card back: identical for all three reads so they can't be told apart face-down
Offense specials deck back: offense palette, distinct pattern from the play deck
